name: DiagnosticSanitizerV1
input: registered DiagnosticEventV1 with event-code-specific allowlisted context schema
pipeline: reject raw domain/model/request/response/database/provider/workbook/message objects at call-site adapter
validate event code has registered context schema and sensitivity classification
walk only allowlisted scalar/list/object fields to depth<=5 and <=64 collection items
for identifiers prefer purpose-created correlation IDs; business identifiers only when event schema explicitly permits
URL sanitizer retains only allowed scheme/host/port/path class; strips userinfo/query/fragment and rejects unexpected schemes
header sanitizer uses name allowlist and rejects Authorization,Cookie,Set-Cookie,X-SOMA-Run-Auth,X-SOMA-CSRF and unknown sensitive headers
exception sanitizer emits registered safe exception code/class and bounded approved fields; arbitrary str(exception)/args are excluded
traceback sanitizer emits SOMA module-relative source location/function/line only; no locals/environment/user absolute paths
apply defense-in-depth recognizable-secret/body canary pattern redaction to already-allowlisted strings
prohibited_classes: private filesystem content/path unless explicitly path-classified
sanitizer_failure: omit unsafe field; if core record cannot be proved safe drop the entire diagnostic event, increment an in-memory dropped counter and never recursively log the sanitizer failure with raw input
sink_failure: drop/bound according to queue policy without altering authoritative operation result
rotation: JSON Lines UTF-8 records; owner-only directory; 10 MiB max/file, 10 files, 30-day max age; rotate only diagnostics
rules: support export reruns current sanitizer/canaries rather than copying logs blindly
